plan_name: MiniBoard Software Factory End-to-End Orchestration Plan

structured_output.notes: Created the comprehensive product specification for MiniBoard adhering to stdlib-only Python 3, SQLite, and vanilla HTML/CSS/JS constraints without external dependencies.
structured_output.summary: Created complete MiniBoard product specification in docs/SPECIFICATION.md including SQLite schema, REST API contract, static asset serving, backend interface create_server, testing requirements with 12-step smoke test, and frontend requirements.

structured_output.notes: Built strictly using Python 3 standard library (http.server, sqlite3, json, threading, urllib). All operations are thread-safe and isolated per-connection. Ephemeral port binding, daemon server thread lifecycle, clean shutdown, and security constraints on path traversal are implemented according to the specification.
structured_output.summary: Implemented MiniBoard backend in app/server.py and app/database.py with SQLite storage, full REST API endpoints, static file serving, and programmatic create_server factory.

structured_output.notes: Zero third-party dependencies used. Implemented responsive layout with mobile-first adaptivity, HTML5 drag-and-drop, inline title editing, explicit transition buttons, deletion with confirmation, banner notifications for success/error states, and periodic health checks against /health.
structured_output.summary: Implemented the complete MiniBoard web frontend in web/index.html, web/style.css, and web/app.js featuring responsive Kanban board with TODO, DOING, and DONE columns, task creation, inline title editing, drag-and-drop and button-based status transitions, task deletion, and notification handling interfacing with /api/tasks.

structured_output.notes: All tests and smoke scripts use only the Python 3 standard library (unittest, tempfile, urllib.request, sqlite3, threading, json, os, sys, pathlib). Each test case dynamically manages server lifecycle on ephemeral ports (port=0) with isolated temporary SQLite databases, ensuring thread-safe concurrency and no port or file locks. Clean teardowns guarantee complete resource release.
structured_output.summary: Implemented comprehensive Python 3 standard library unit/integration tests in tests/test_api.py, persistence verification in tests/test_persistence.py, and a standalone 12-step deterministic end-to-end smoke verification script in scripts/smoke_test.py.

structured_output.notes: All changes strictly adhere to Python standard library and vanilla web technologies with zero third-party dependencies. Verified route contracts, ephemeral port handling, SQLite schema constraints, persistence across restarts, and frontend DOM robustness.
structured_output.summary: Completed integration and quality verification of MiniBoard. Created tests/__init__.py test package marker as required by the specification. Enhanced app/server.py with resilient connection teardown, exact /api 404 routing, and socket error handling. Hardened web/app.js with safe DOM creation and robust asynchronous task indexing. Expanded tests/test_api.py with test coverage for single task retrieval, route edge cases, and CORS preflight.

findings.evidence: app/server.py:77-79: _read_json_body() requires Content-Length header to parse JSON payload.
findings.recommendation: For standard REST API usage Content-Length is standard; if supporting arbitrary chunked transfer encoding in HTTP/1.1 in future iterations, consider supporting chunked reader fallback.

findings.evidence: web/app.js:323: window.confirm() is used to confirm task deletion.
findings.recommendation: While functional and lightweight, replacing the browser's native window.confirm dialog with an in-DOM accessible modal dialog would match the styling of the custom notification banner.

findings.evidence: app/database.py:16-18: get_connection() initializes SQLite connection with foreign keys enabled in default journal mode.
findings.recommendation: Enabling SQLite Write-Ahead Logging (PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL;) can further improve concurrent read/write concurrency across multiple worker threads.

structured_output.summary: Comprehensive audit of the MiniBoard codebase against docs/SPECIFICATION.md completed. The implementation strictly adheres to all architectural principles and product requirements: zero third-party dependencies (strictly standard library and vanilla web technologies), fully compliant SQLite persistence and schema integrity with CHECK constraints, robust REST API contracts with accurate status codes and JSON error formatting, complete static asset serving with directory traversal guards, responsive Kanban frontend with inline editing and drag-and-drop interactions, and exhaustive test coverage across test_api.py, test_persistence.py, and the 12-step standalone smoke_test.py.
